character.description: The same young adult female anime protagonist: warm chestnut hair in a high ponytail, violet eyes, a confident gaze and a small, knowing smile; a thoughtful everyday traveler with a keen eye for small moments, wearing a recognizable contemporary outfit with a signature jacket, simple accessories, and comfortable shoes with cedar brown accents. Keep this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, and signature outfit in every scene.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist identity in every scene; do not redesign, replace, or randomly reinterpret the character.
Preserve the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, defining accessories, and main color accents consistent across the entire music video.
Do not introduce another protagonist unless the lyrics or scene explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in outdoor stone bath in snow, wooden inn with lit windows, snowy path with lanterns; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with steam white, snow blue, lantern amber, cedar brown; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow push-in through rising steam, wide shot of a snowy mountain inn, low shot of snow falling on hot water; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
